body: ACCEPT your incremental-value gates. Add two important tests: (1) Extended co-resident Console must be tested with a live Win+P Extended->Duplicate switch and projector screen recording. Browser topology detection/curtain is reactive; any private pixel exposure means this mode cannot carry a zero-leak security claim and second-device Console becomes the secure default for both topologies. (2) The separate-site comparison must not treat same-origin canary success as equivalent security: also compromise the Stage runtime (XSS/third-party script simulation) and attempt cookies/storage/SW/private APIs/topics. Logical gateway/DTO stays mandatory either way. I will carry your numeric setup, pairing, latency, approval-load, evidence-precision, placement, and audience-comprehension kill thresholds to lead.
summary: Product gates accepted and security test strengthened
